newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan closes down at intra-day low vs US dollar.
newsitem.headline: Yuan closes down at intra-day low vs US dollar.

text.p: SHANGHAI, Oct 24 ( Reuter) - The Chinese yuan closed down on Thursday at an intra-day low of 8.3023 against the U.S. dollar from Wednesday's 8.3000 on the Shanghai-based interbank foreign exchange market.
Dealers said last-minute trading pushed the yuan to close at an intra-day low.

The yuan opened unchanged at 8.3000 and rose to an intra-day high of 8.2993 early in the session. It then fell to consolidate to 8.3010 for most of the session before plunging in the last few minutes.
Trading was dull early on but active late in the session, with most done at 8.3003 and 8.3010, traders said.
"The central bank was seen intervening in the market to push the yuan below 8.3000 and speculative selling made the yuan slide further," one dealer said.
"The final falls may hurt market sentiment to some extent but such late falls usually have little impact on trading in the next day," said a second dealer.
Dealers expect the yuan to rise to around 8.3010 on Friday.
The yuan closed up at 7.3200 from 7.3620 against 100 Japanese yen following the yen's fall against the U.S. dollar in world markets.
The yuan closed down at 1.0748 from 1.0741 against the Hong Kong dollar.
